findings.statement: Parent order P-AAPL-1400 (BUY 60,000 AAPL via VWAP) executed 52,000 shares across 216 fills on 5 venues.

Execution VWAP 229.2668 versus interval VWAP 229.2506: slippage +0.7 bps (baseline +1.2 bps, delta -0.5 bps).
Fill rate was 86.7% of the parent quantity with participation of 5.1% of market volume.
Execution quality did not materially deteriorate versus the baseline: implementation shortfall delta -11.0 bps, slippage-vs-VWAP delta -0.5 bps.
Observed participation 5.1% was within the configured VWAP ceiling of 20% (target 8.0%) - behaviour consistent with the strategy configuration and runbook.
Execution latency remained within the normal range (0.98x baseline, p99 1002 us).
Realised volatility (3.35 bps/min) was in line with the baseline (1.02x).
Average quoted spread (1.85 bps) was in line with the baseline (0.99x).
Displayed liquidity was normal (98% of baseline depth).
No deployments to the execution path occurred in the hour before or during the window.
No ERROR-level log events were recorded in the window.
No candidate cause scored as material; the window is statistically consistent with the baseline.
Market-data feed quality was normal (no stale runs or crossed quotes of note).
No venue was materially worse than its peers on fill rate or slippage.
Post-window gross exposure in AAPL was 51,140,674 USD (34% of the notional limit).
